name: Shinohara Kaori
source:
She is Yuusuke's classmate and the daughter of a real estate agent with strong ties to Mutoh Heavy Industries. She is beautiful, intelligent, and self-aware. She tries to win Ryota's favor in order to marry into wealth, and has succeeded in becoming his girlfriend. She longs for Tokyo and plans to move there after graduation.

[From the [url=https://www.melonbooks.co.jp/detail/detail.php?product_id=3764144]Megastore October 2026 Issue.[/url]]
